reviewer.notes: Cross-vendor re-derivation from live Linux probe raws, not from harvest UNIT-COMPLETE. Probe A: signed postinstall fixture refused with ValidationFailed additionalProperties postinstall; host marker absent; site payload not copied. Probe B: installer output and independent mkt validate both name the unknown postinstall field. Controls: direct canary writes TST0217-RAN and the absence oracle goes red then silent; both-states owner-gate produces the marker only inside the sandbox directory. refute_rederive.py confirms package-manifest additionalProperties=false, postinstall not a declared property, and install.py has 0 postinstall/subprocess/Popen/os.system/scripts tokens. Catalog names a Codex security reviewer plus a fresh-context correctness reviewer; this session reproduced both-states by a second method under one independent reviewer (grok). A Codex MCP dispatch was not available.
